translations.zh: 使為國者每念稼穡之勞，而其后妃不忘織絍之事，則心不存者寡矣。
translations.literal: If those who govern the state always remember the labor of sowing and reaping, and their consorts never forget the work of spinning hemp thread—then those without such a heart would be few.
translations.idiomatic: If rulers always kept in mind the toil of sowing and reaping, and their consorts never forgot the labor of spinning and weaving, few hearts would remain untouched by such feeling.

translations.zh: 長師胡宏，宏一見，即以孔門論仁親切之旨告之。
translations.literal: When grown he took Hu Hong as teacher; at their first meeting Hu Hong immediately told him the intimate purpose of the Confucian school's discourse on humaneness.
translations.idiomatic: As a young man he studied under Hu Hong, who at their very first meeting expounded to him the inner meaning of the sage school's teaching on humaneness.
